headline: No. 2 USC Tests Road Mettle at Struggling Miami
subhead: The Trojans bring the PCFL's third-ranked offense to Coral Gables against a Hurricanes defense allowing 355.5 yards per game.

xFactor.why: Miller Moss leads the PCFL with 715 passing yards and five touchdowns through two weeks.

keyMatchup: USC's 349-yard passing attack versus a Miami secondary that has allowed 343.5 yards through the air per game.
body: USC arrives at 2-0 and No. 2 in the power poll behind an offense averaging 475 yards and 31 points per game, paced by Miller Moss (715 yards, 5 TD), Carter Myers (152 rushing yards, 1 TD) and Connor Burnett (288 receiving yards, 1 TD), while David Johnson paces the PCFL with three sacks.

Miami sits 0-2 and has dropped to No. 14 after allowing 36.5 points per game; the Hurricanes' 412.5-yard offense leans heavily on the pass (343.5 YPG) with Carlos Campen leading receivers at 110 yards, but the ground game has managed only 69 yards per contest.
